messages.author: 2935e7de556025cb
messages.subject: Shiny server timeframe?
parts:
Hi,

I wanted to say that I started using Shiny last week and am blown away by how useful this is! I work on a project that conducts vegetable variety trials throughout the country and I was able to, in a couple hours, build an app that allowed us to easily visualize the trial data. A colleague had been working on a similar task in Drupal for over a year...

My question is, and I apologize for any impertinence, but, is there any ballpark for when a shiny server will be available? Any any idea of the likely pricing? I ask because our project is weighing what the best approach will be for sharing our data with the public, and, if shiny server was going to be available in the next year or so and reasonably priced, we'll probably keep investigating it as a very good tool for sharing our data. I know that software development is never 100% certain, but I was just wondering about a very general ballpark.

Thank you so much for all of your work in creating such a wonderful product!

Jared
